overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long ASTS Daily ETF (ASTX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of AST SpaceMobile, Inc. stock. ASTX was launched on Jul 10, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
